lines.3: 「Good. All that's left is to make the rounds of the club building.」
lines.7: 「There was an argument inside the drama club. It was awful.」
lines.8: 「An argument? Even with Konoe as president keeping things under control?」
lines.9: 「President Konoe was the cause of it.」
lines.10: 「If they're still fighting, I'll go mediate.」
lines.11: 「It's over now. Everyone's completely worn out.」
lines.13: 「Everyone is already busy, and President Konoe brought us even more hard work. Of course people argued.」
lines.14: 「I see... So it caused a fight.」
lines.16: 「Tachibana, is it all right to postpone the executive-committee training camp we had planned for tomorrow?」
lines.17: 「Yes. Everyone is busy preparing for the Sports and Martial Arts Festival.」
lines.18: 「Preparations are unusually hectic this year. Understood.」
